One of these Nights: The Ultimate Tribute to the Eagles
events.description:
Get ready to be transported back to the golden era of classic rock! This extraordinary band brings to life the timeless music of the Eagles,. From their flawless harmonies to their electrifying guitar solos, every note and lyric is expertly recreated, delivering an authentic and captivating performance and channeling their unique blend of rock, country, and folk into an unforgettable live experience.

Part of the Watford City Area Concert Series

Become a member to receive full access to all three concerts in the series, plus our reciprocity concerts or purchase individual tickets
